decisions.statement: The pair a push carries is the access token and the refresh token.
A push merges the pair into the keys the sops file already has.
A sops file already with the pair is answered as unchanged.
A sops file answered as unchanged is landed again by nothing.
A token that is empty is refused.
A token with a newline is refused.
An expiry that is no moment a date holds is refused.
A push whose expiry is no later than the expiry beside the page is answered as stale.
A push answered as stale writes no file.
A page beside which no expiry is written makes no push stale.
The file that landed is read back through sops and weighed against the pair handed in.
A sops file reading back a different pair from the pair handed in is refused.
Every push that lands stamps the moment the access token expires.
A push that lands and does not stamp the expiry is refused.
The change adding a file writes the sops file rather than an edit composed here.
A landing that does not have the pair has that pair beside the page.
A read-back that does not answer the pair has that pair beside the page.
The pair held beside the page is written under `rescuedCredential`.
The file the pair is held in is narrowed to its owner before that pair is written.
A push that lands takes the rescued pair away.
A push answered as unchanged takes the rescued pair away.
An account name that is no lower kebab-case slug is refused.
A name refused for its shape is refused before a file is opened.
An account no page is filed for is answered as absent.
Every value written beside the page goes through the marking module.
Writing a push answers with an outcome rather than throwing.
A push that threw after it committed names that commit in its refusal.
A push that threw has the pair beside the page as a refused landing does.
A rescue that throws is said rather than thrown, so a push still answers.
Pushing one account's credential opens that account's page and no other page.
Pushing one account's credential lists no directory the accounts are filed under.
The repository root reaches this module as a parameter.
The reader of an account's secrets reaches this module as a parameter.
The composer of an account's ciphertext reaches this module as a parameter.
The landing reaches this module as a parameter.
The reading of the index reaches this module as a parameter.
The reader of page bodies reaches this module as a parameter.
A caller names the account a push is written for.
The moment an access token expires is handed in by the caller.
Nothing here reads a clock.
Nothing here fetches.
Nothing here decrypts.
Nothing here encrypts.
No secret value reaches a log here.
No digest of a token is answered.
Nothing here writes into a page's own body.
No reader of a page body is built here from the root.
Nothing here reads a second account to push the account named.
A rescued pair is held unencrypted in the file beside the page.
A pair landed in sops without its expiry stamp is unreachable by the reader.
Narrowing for a rescued pair narrows every other reading beside that page.
A pair rescued twice is written over by the second rescue.
Every mark a push writes reaches the account's page a second time.
Narrowing before the write is proven at a refused mark rather than at a mark that lands.

definition: how a rotated credential reaches an account's sops file
